<section class="intro" aria-labelledby="intro-title">

    <p class="eyebrow">ORGANIC GEOCHEMISTRY · PALEOCLIMATE</p>
    <h1 id="intro-title">Ricardo N. Santos</h1>
    <p class="position">Molecular paleoclimatologist</p>
    <p class="intro-lead">Reading the past through the molecules preserved in lake sediments.</p>
    <p>I’m an organic geochemist and geologist working on lipid biomarkers, compound-specific stable isotopes, and lake-sediment archives. I study how hydroclimate, vegetation, and human activity have shaped environments from the last deglaciation to the present.</p>
    <p>A central question in my research is how to interpret the signals preserved in sedimentary lipid biomarkers. What fascinates me is that a single lipid record can reflect the intertwined histories of climate, vegetation, lake ecology, and human impact.</p>
